channel.title: Nature Physics
channel.description: Nature Physics offers news and reviews alongside top-quality research papers in a monthly publication, covering the entire spectrum of physics. Physics addresses the properties and interactions of matter and energy, and plays a key role in the development of a broad range of technologies. To reflect this, Nature Physics covers all areas of pure and applied physics research. The journal focuses on core physics disciplines, but is also open to a broad range of topics whose central theme falls within the bounds of physics.

item.title: [9] Time-domain identification of distinct mechanisms for competing charge density waves in a rare-earth tritelluride
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Eugene Demler, Nuh Gedik

Authors: Yifan Su, B. Q. Lv, Alfred Zong, et al.

Score 9/10 A_MUST_READ

Why: author whitelist: Nuh Gedik

Tags: #STS #chargedensitywave

Abstract: ErTe3 hosts two charge-density-wave orders and the origin of the weaker one remains unclear. Tracking its recovery after light excitation now points to nucleation and growth as the underlying mechanism.

item.title: [6] Orbitronics becomes disorder-resilient
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Samik DuttaGupta

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Adjacent interest in orbitronics and angular momentum transport in thin films.

Tags: #transport #material #orbitronics

Abstract: It is unclear whether crystalline disorder can suppress angular momentum transport. Now, a study reveals the disorder resilience of such transport and uncovers distinct orbital relaxation processes across a wide range of disordered thin films.
